name: Ticketio Frontend
postCreateCommand:
npm install && ng analytics off && mkdir -p /workspace/.devcontainer/scripts && echo '#!/bin/bash
ng serve --host 0.0.0.0 --port 4200 --proxy-config proxy.conf.json' > /workspace/.devcontainer/scripts/serve.sh && chmod +x /workspace/.devcontainer/scripts/serve.sh && ln -s /workspace/.devcontainer/scripts/serve.sh /usr/local/bin/serve
